claims.value: 51 Orbitrap Elite RAW files from GFP and SHARPIN-GFP pull-downs, represented as gel fractions in two experiments.
claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol and deposited result-archive names mapping GJ1-10 to GFP, GJ11-20 to SHARPIN suspension, and GJ21-30 to SHARPIN fibronectin groups.

limitations: The GFP control adhesion state is not specified and remains not available.
The second experiment deposits seven rather than ten RAW fractions per group; original GJ numbering is preserved by file names.
